messages:
Anya Patel: Kicking off POC scoping for Acme. Need a compact prompt inventory + baseline prompts for a 2-week pilot. Constraints: EU data residency, budget cap ~$12k, acceptance: hallucination <5% on eval, p95 latency <300ms, throughput ~50 rps. Who owns inventory?

Jordan Lee: I can own the inventory. Quick Q: Hosted first or Dedicated day 1? Pricing impacts budget.

Anya Patel: Prefer Hosted to start. @Leila Gomez can you confirm EU KMS + no-external-logging requirement?

Leila Gomez: EU KMS required. Security noted 'no external logging' and audit retention. For the POC we can disable request logging in Hosted; Legal needs a signed DPA before prod. Dropping SQA answers in the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/EXAMPLE_LINK

Sam Ortiz: Recommend testing two model families: open-7b quantized (cost-optimized) and redwood-rlhf-1 (higher-quality). Baseline prompt families: A) single-turn summarization, B) multi-turn action extraction, C) structured JSON extraction. Target eval set ~200 examples + small adversarial set for hallucinations. Sample baseline prompt (copyable):

```
Prompt: "Given the customer conversation, produce a short summary, 3 recommended next actions (prioritized), and a confidence score between 0 and 1. Output MUST be valid JSON with keys: summary, actions, confidence."
Input tag: <customer_conversation>
Max tokens: 150
Temperature: 0.0
Output format: JSON
```

Jordan Lee: Add negative-class eval cases where model returns "no_answer" or "insufficient_info". Assume ~200 tokens/request for cost projections.

Anya Patel: Proposed timeline: inventory + sample prompts in 48h, curated evals by Friday, automated test pass next Monday. Owners: Jordan = inventory & cost estimates, Sam = prompt baseline & eval harness, Leila = security sign-off & SQA.

Anya Patel: @redwood-deploy-bot create POC workspace and grant Jordan & Sam access (they need customer sandbox + token controls).

redwood-deploy-bot: Created workspace "poc-acme-171772" and granted access to @Jordan Lee, @Sam Ortiz. Logging disabled and EU KMS flag set. :rocket:

Leila Gomez: Legal: DPA required before Dedicated/prod. Confirm if HSM is required; lead time ~2 weeks if so.

Sam Ortiz: I'll draft 3 prompt variants per family (concise, context-rich, instruction-heavy) and include a pytest-based eval runner. Example eval commands: 

```
pytest tests/evals/test_hallucination.py -k smoke
python tools/eval_runner.py --model redwood-rlhf-1 --dataset datasets/acme_eval.json --out results.json
```

Jordan Lee: I'll populate the inventory sheet with sample prompts, expected outputs, failure modes, and token estimates. I'll also add Hosted vs Dedicated cost projections for both model families.

Anya Patel: Once we have first-pass cost + security answers we'll provide Sales a one-pager: scope, timeline, success criteria, estimated cost. Daily async updates in this thread please. :thumbsup:

Jordan Lee: First pass in shared sheet by EOD today.

Sam Ortiz: Draft prompts and initial eval harness uploaded to workspace; will iterate after inventory.

Leila Gomez: Pinged Legal for DPA; will update when signed.

Anya Patel: Owners/deliverables reiterated in sheet. Daily standups optional; prefer async updates here.
